揺.visual: Left upright hand with two short projecting fingers. Right three fingertips float above a short rail crossed by an upright and a solid wide U-shaped container with one short middle prong. Boy steadies the bottom.

既.memory: A divided left panel and a curled right stand show something finished.

隠.visual: Left slim tall cliff with two projecting ledges. Right three little accents over a short box with two horizontal fold lines, then one red heart with two distinct dots below. Boy peeks from behind the cliff.

哲.memory: A hand and hinged fixture sit over a speaking mouth.
哲.visual: Top left a narrow upright forearm. Top right a tilted cap and long hanging post on a short rail. Below both one bold square speaking mouth. Boy thinks next to the open window.

杉.visual: Left one tall cedar with prominent trunk, crossed boughs and splayed roots. Right exactly three separate parallel golden sweeps descending diagonally down-left. Boy notices the tree rings in one swing.

妥.memory: Fingertips rest above a woman's crossed pose.
妥.visual: Above a gentle hand with three hanging fingers spreads horizontally. Below center one adult figure with visibly crossed legs and a wide outstretched arm. Boy offers a little flower at lower right.

威.visual: A big angled roof and a sloping beam curling up to the right wrap around the scene, with one small offset dot. Inside an adult figure with crossed feet and a broad arm. Boy stands respectfully outside.

豪.memory: A tall roof and square opening sit above flowing ribbons.
豪.visual: Stack a dot and short cap, square opening and broad low eave. Beneath, one central curled ribbon and two parallel left sweeps plus one long right sweep. Boy looks up at the grand scale.

微.visual: Left two angled steps and an upright. Center three little peaks above a rail on two curved feet. Right an angle above a pair of crossed braces. Boy examines the tiny peak through a magnifier.

隆.visual: Left a high narrow cliff with two ledges. Right two crossing tracks over one short horizontal divider and one little sprout that has three branches crossing the stem. Boy climbs near the sprout.

症.visual: A small cap above a ledge that drops down the left, with two separate dots outside that left side. Inside right one upright over a long flat foot and two short step bars. Boy points to a tiny check marker without text.

肝.memory: A ribbed body panel sits beside two straight rails.

妙.visual: Left an adult woman with crossing feet and one wide arm. Right a tall narrow stem with two detached side drops above a single longer diagonal ribbon that sweeps down-left. Boy gestures toward the delicate tip.

索.memory: A cross and cover hang above a folded cord.
索.visual: Stack a short cross over a broad low cover. Below, one thick folded cord and three separate loose tips. Boy holds one dangling end beside the cord.

襲.memory: A tall dragon crest towers above a broad robe.

剤.visual: Left a small dot and cap above two crossing arms, one shelf through two downward supports. Right two slim bars, taller one curls at bottom. Boy measures one tiny round bead.

瀬.memory: Three drops meet a bundle and tall page near rushing water.
瀬.visual: Left three drops. Middle short rail crossing a divided square above two slanted feet. Right a short cap and a tall rectangular plate with two bars over two splayed feet. Boy watches one tiny rapid at bottom.

趣.memory: A running trail reaches a tall ear and two crossed bands.
趣.visual: Left short ground cross over a sweeping foot path that curves right under the rest. Right tall upright ear with two inside lines, next to two crosswise ribbon ends. Boy runs toward them.

陥.memory: A narrow hillside drops toward a dark pocket.
陥.visual: Left a taller ridge with two distinct ledges. Right one short bent top cap over a divided square lowered into a small opening. Boy looks down from a secure edge.

斎.memory: Crossed ribbons rest above a clean three-legged stand.
斎.visual: Place a dotted cap over two distinct crossed ribbons. Beneath them a wide bar intersects one center stem and two shorter slanting strokes. Boy places a water bead beside it.

貫.memory: A pierced chest sits above an upright shell.
貫.visual: Top tilted box with one horizontal beam extending through both sides and a vertical central stem. Under it a large shell with two horizontal bars and two splayed feet. Boy pushes a tiny cord through one slot.

仙.memory: A person who lives alone stands beside mountain peaks.
仙.visual: Left narrow boy silhouette standing upright. Right exactly three stone peaks rising from one unmistakable base, middle highest. Keep boy and mountain close but visibly side by side.

慰.memory: A shelter and a measured hook sit directly above a warm heart.
慰.visual: Upper left overhang shelters two rails and three little legs underneath. Upper right a tall hook with crossbar and dot. Directly below both a warm red heart with two short side marks. Boy rests beside it.

旬.memory: A curved cap wraps around a divided sun tile.
旬.visual: One broad cap bends down on the right and hooks in. Inside the hook, low left, one clear upright square sun with a single horizontal line. Boy points to the tile; no digits.

兼.memory: Two sets of rails share straight central posts.
兼.visual: Two short tilted accents above a compact stack of three bars, crossed by two straight posts close together. At base split into two diagonal arms. Boy fits the two sets together.

旨.memory: A small loop above a divided box marks a tasty portion.
旨.visual: At top a narrow slanted tab with one long curling foot. Directly below it one square food window with a bold middle stripe. Boy sniffs a little snack near the window.

即.memory: A divided frame sits directly beside a tall hanging clasp.
即.visual: Left a narrow rectangular block with two inner lines and a short angled foot. Right a box-shouldered hook with one straight leg, slightly separated from left. Boy clips a token on it.

柳.memory: A drooping willow stands beside two rising hooks.
柳.visual: Left one tall willow with clear cross-shaped branches and two splayed roots. Right exactly two distinct upright curled shapes, each with a separate upper cap. Boy looks through their gap.

偽.memory: A person tests a bent frame that stands atop four supports.
偽.visual: Boy narrow at far left. Right an offset dot above a long curled beam with a folded shoulder. Below it exactly four short detached supports. Boy compares one imitation chip.

較.memory: A cart stands beside two crossed tracks.
較.visual: Left square cart with center axle and two horizontal bars. Right dotted cap and short rail over two strong trails crossing in an X. Boy compares two little wheels beside the intersection.

覇.memory: A wide divided window covers a leather rack and moon panel.
覇.visual: Top a broad shallow window with clear panes. Below left a divided leather frame with two uprights and low cross foot, below right a tall rounded two-bar tile. Boy studies the larger rack.

詳.memory: Speech lines describe a sheep with clear fleece ribs.
詳.visual: Left dot, stacked speech marks and square mouth. Right exactly two curved horns above three fleece bars joined to a single upright. Boy counts the little bands.

抵.memory: A hand braces a long curled support above a detached dot.
抵.visual: Left tall hand silhouette. Right angled cap and one crossing rail above a single long diagonal curling up at lower right, plus one detached low dot. Boy braces near the curve.

脅.memory: Three hooked supports sit above a ribbed body tile.
脅.visual: Top three distinct rounded levers, one centered high and two lower side by side. Directly below a tall rounded two-bar tile. Boy steadies the arrangement from outside.

茂.memory: Dense grass crowns a folded, hooked shelter.
茂.visual: Two visible tufts at top. Below a broad ledge sweeps down-left; long diagonal swings down-right to a curled point with one distinct offset dot. Boy peeks between grass and ledge.

犠.memory: A cattle marker sits beside a crowned display with a curled hook.
犠.visual: Left one short horned cow silhouette around a straight stem and two rails. Right two horn tabs over short rails and a long diagonal crossed hook with one small dot. Boy places a symbolic flower offering beneath it.

距.memory: A running foot meets a large open-sided frame.
距.visual: Left a square ankle block and a splayed foot going down-right. Right one tall left stem, two long enclosing rails facing right, and a small middle rectangular bay sharing the same stem. Boy measures between both shapes.

雅.memory: A hooked stem stands beside a striped graceful bird.
雅.visual: Left a stem crosses two rails before curling at the foot, with one angled branch to lower left. Right a tall slim bird with four narrow horizontal plumage bars. Boy watches it calmly.

飾.memory: A food tray stands beside a hanging banner.
飾.visual: Left a pointed cover over a divided tray with an angled base. Right a short tilted cap above a small square cloth hanging from a straight stand with extended middle seam. Boy ties a patterned ribbon on it.

網.memory: Thread fastens a covered net with a bent inner rail.
網.visual: Left narrow folded thread with three separated ends. Right tall open-bottom frame, two tiny inner accents above one squared bent rail beneath. Boy fastens a net corner with a thread.

竜.memory: A little dragon curls beneath a short upright crown.
竜.visual: Stack a small pedestal shape with dot and broad little foot above a square divided panel. Its bold center stem continues underneath into a long curled dragon tail. Boy watches the friendly dragon.

繁.memory: Two crossed upper frames sit above a spreading thread.
繁.visual: Top left tilted plant frame around two dots and top right two crossing sticks below a slant. Center thick folded pink thread with three separate loose tips below them. Boy catches one end.

翼.memory: Two wings fly over a field and its supports.
翼.visual: Two folded wings fit shoulder to shoulder across the top with two marks in each. Under them one four-pane square field and then a shared stand with two distinct feet. Boy looks upward.

潟.memory: Three drops enclose a divided shore above four ripples.
潟.visual: Three droplets left. Right shallow square scoop with a broken top edge above a long hooked shore rail enclosing four separate little water ripples below. Boy watches beside the lower shore.

魅.memory: A curled friendly figure meets a growing tree-shaped rail.
魅.visual: Left boxy figure with a divided face above two curled feet and side knot. Right tall stem through two horizontal boughs and two splayed roots. Boy watches the tiny figure.

嫌.memory: A woman stands beside a two-stem rack with crossed feet.
嫌.visual: Left an adult with clearly crossing steps and an outstretched arm. Right two short accents over three horizontal rails crossed by two verticals then fanning apart. Boy notices her skeptical look from outside.

斉.memory: Crossed ribbons top a pair of standing guides.
斉.visual: Top dot and rail then two clearly crossed ribbon strips. Below, one shorter support slants slightly left and the other stands straight. One short rail crosses them near the base. Boy checks the alignment.

敷.memory: An upright rack and flag stand beside two crossed braces.
敷.visual: Left a divided top panel with a top peg and little dot over a narrow flag and curved lower rod. Right small angled cap and short rail above two crossing braces. Boy spreads a fabric corner across the bottom gap.

擁.memory: A hand reaches toward a tall bird with a curled crest.
擁.visual: Left tall wrist and projecting short fingers. Right small dotted cap over a curled accent and an upright striped bird. Boy reaches warmly from the bottom while keeping the two sides clear.

圏.memory: A square fence surrounds a stepped coil.
圏.visual: An outer square enclosure contains a short pair of accents and two tiers of bars directly above a curled strip. Boy stands just outside one corner. Leave clear space between curl and enclosure.

罰.memory: A divided window covers speech beside two narrow rails.
罰.visual: Top one shallow four-pane window. Under it speech bars and a square opening on left, two slender upright guides on right. Boy removes one small game counter.

滅.memory: Water ends a small flame beneath a long hooked cover.
滅.visual: Three drops left. Right a diagonal ledge curls up at the far end with a tiny offset dot. One short inner bar above a little flame or glowing ember nestled under the roof. Boy observes safely from the side.

礎.memory: A square stone stands beside two trees above a broad footing.
礎.visual: Left a long slanted ledge over a square stone. Right two distinct narrow trees side by side above one straight rail and a path splaying down-left and right. Boy checks the foot of the foundation.

腐.memory: An old shelter covers a marked frame above a fleshy box.
腐.visual: Across top and left one long shelter with cap. Inside, narrow person and short hooked measure stand over one square open-bottom frame with two downward branching marks. Boy observes a tiny faded leaf at one corner.

脚.memory: A ribbed body tile stands beside a folded knee and clasp.
脚.visual: Left long rounded body panel with two stripes. Right a little earth cross with angular curl below, then a slim shoulder hook at far right. Boy touches one knee.

尽.memory: A sloped panel ends above two separated marks.
尽.visual: Large top panel drops into a long left slant and a right open sweep. Below it exactly two short diagonal marks offset from each other. Boy tips an empty little container nearby.

僕.memory: A person stands by a tiered rack and its broad feet.
僕.visual: Boy in narrow upright silhouette at left. Right three small accents above a rail, then two shelves crossed by a central stem, ending in two splayed supports. Boy taps one small token on his chest.

滑.memory: Three drops sit beside a bony box over a ribbed panel.
滑.visual: Left three blue drops. Right a squared upper notch and broad overhanging rim above a tall rounded panel with two stripes. Boy keeps balance beside a tiny slippery patch.

孤.memory: A child stands beside a curved solitary vine.
孤.visual: Left child bent low with one outstretched horizontal arm and a hooked foot. Right a short slanted cap over two curved supports with a small loop between them. Boy sits quietly near the gap.

炎.memory: One smaller flame rises directly above a larger flame.
炎.visual: Stack exactly two separate orange flame silhouettes, one smaller on top. Each has two little side sparks and a broad point. Boy watches from outside the shapes.

賠.memory: A shell purse pays a little speaking booth.
賠.visual: Left a tall rectangular shell purse with two inside bars and two separated feet. Right a dotted short cap above a stand with splayed braces over one square speaking opening. Boy offers a coin.

頑.memory: Two curled feet brace against a tall head-shaped panel.
頑.visual: Left two rails over two outward legs, right one deeply curled. Right a short cap and tall rectangular head marker with two inside stripes and little feet. Boy thinks beside it.

鎖.memory: Metal forms a height of links over a boxy shell.
鎖.visual: Left a peaked gold cap over stacked bars and two tiny ingots. Right three little diagonal accents above a tall shell with two strong interior bars and two splayed supports. Boy connects one short chain to the shell.

彩.memory: Fingers color a tree beside three slanted strokes.
彩.visual: Left three little fingertips over a tall 木 tree. Right exactly three parallel diagonal paint trails, descending down-left with visible gaps. Boy holds a small paintbrush at the edge of the lowest trail.

摩.memory: Two branches under a shelter sit above a broad hand.
摩.visual: At top broad roof and left sweep around two side-by-side mini trees. Beneath the pair put one large hand with three finger tiers and long wrist. Boy rubs wood gently from one side.

励.memory: A short sheltered lever stands beside a curved force lever.
励.visual: Left sloped overhang covering one small curled upright with a broad top bar. Right a larger curved lever with one hook and one slanted support. Boy cheers beside the levers.

輝.memory: A light on two feet sits next to a covered cart.
輝.visual: Left three sparks above one long rail and two curved splayed feet. Right a broad cover above a square divided cart with tall center axle. Boy points to one strong glint.

蓄.memory: Grass crowns a tied knot above a four-pane field.
蓄.visual: Top two grass sprigs on one rail. Middle short cap dot and angular folded cord. Bottom exactly one bold four-pane square storage plot with small goods tucked inside. Boy moves a parcel inside.

軸.memory: A cart rolls beside a divided frame with a projecting peg.
軸.visual: Left square cart with two inside horizontal bars and center axle extending beyond top and bottom. Right square field with one center upright projecting above the top. Boy points out the wheel axle at the base.

巡.memory: Three streams sit next to a path that curls underneath.
巡.visual: At upper right three upright wavy streams stand next to one another. Left a single stepping dot and a wide orange road bend around the left and underneath all three. Boy patrols the road.

稼.memory: A grain stalk stands beside a roofed bundle.
稼.visual: At left one tall grain stalk with crossed boughs and splayed roots. At right a broad roof with top dot over a curled bundle with three lower sweeping strands. Boy carries a tiny harvest basket beside the roof.

瞬.memory: An eye blinks next to a tiered frame with two footprints.
瞬.visual: Left one tall boxy eye with two inner bars. Right a short row of fingers above a broad cap, then two little slanted feet beneath it. Boy blinks beside the eye.

砲.memory: A square stone sits beside a wrapper around a curled parcel.
砲.visual: Left a slanted stone ledge over a blocky stone. Right a big curved cap wraps around one smaller squared ribbon that curls upward at the bottom. Boy explores these two abstract mnemonic objects in a museum.

噴.memory: A mouth puffs beside a shell under a little crossed rack.
噴.visual: Left one large square mouth. Right a short cross above a wide rail with two upright pegs, directly above a shell with two lines and two separate feet. One tiny puff floats between mouth and rack.

誇.memory: A voice makes a big frame over two straight rails and a hook.
誇.visual: Left speech bars and one square mouth. Right one wide figure with sloping feet over two short horizontal rails and a curled hook. Boy speaks near the mouth.

祥.memory: A narrow altar stands beside a friendly sheep.
祥.visual: Left a top dot above a short altar rail and three little hanging marks. Right two inward horns over three horizontal fleece bands intersected by one upright. Boy leaves a charm by the altar.

牲.memory: A cow marker stands by a little growing stalk.
牲.visual: Left one squat wooden cow with an upright and crossing rails. Right a small tilted top sprout above three horizontal growth rails and one stem. Boy waters a little leaf at its base.

秩.memory: A grain stalk sits beside a tilted crossbar rack with falling feet.
秩.visual: Left tall grain stalk with one slanting spike and two splayed roots. Right a short top accent and long crossing rail, and two large supports spread away from one central stem. Boy lines up the stalk and rack.

帝.memory: A dotted cap shelters a hanging banner.
帝.visual: Stack a small dot, short crossbar with two angled accent strokes and a wide low cover. Under the cover hangs a rectangular cloth with one center seam extending below it. Boy admires it from the edge.

唆.memory: A square mouth invites a curled figure over crossed paths.
唆.visual: Left a large square talking mouth. Right a small angular loop above two slanted accents and a pair of crossed paths. Boy signals from the lower path.

阻.memory: A narrow cliff meets a tall barred slab.
阻.visual: Left thin cliff with two small projecting steps. Right tall rectangular slab with three horizontal inside lines and a broad base. Boy looks at the blocked path beside the slab.

泰.memory: A wide shelter of rails stands over a fan of water.
泰.visual: Top three stacked horizontal bars on one centered upright with two big legs slanting out. Directly below one long water stem opens into four detached splashes. Boy sits peacefully to the side.

賄.memory: A shell purse sits beside a panel under a sloping ledge.
賄.visual: Left tall shell purse with two internal bands and two splayed feet. Right a rail and descending-left slanted cover above a tall two-bar panel. Boy notices one hidden coin by the purse.

撲.memory: A hand taps a spreading rack crossed by several shelves.
撲.visual: Left tall upright hand. Right three small angled vents on a ledge, then two horizontal rails crossed by one long stem and two big slanting feet. Boy taps a toy block near the base.

堀.memory: An earth cross stands by two ledges inside a shelter.
堀.visual: At left a little earth cross with wide base. Right a top-and-left overhang shelters two distinct three-pronged shelves, stacked one above the other. Boy looks down into the gap.

菊.memory: Grass crowns a wrapper around a spreading chrysanthemum.
菊.visual: Two sprouts along the top. Beneath a curled cap rounds over the right side of a bright chrysanthemum whose petals extend in four diagonal directions around a strong central stem. Boy leans in to see it.

絞.memory: Thread winds beside two bands crossing under a dotted cap.
絞.visual: On left folded red skein and three separate tails. Right dotted cap and narrow rail over two wide bands crossing in an X. Boy turns a single loose thread near the gap.

縁.memory: Thread meets a folded cap above several curling strands.
縁.visual: Left folded red thread with three ends. Right a short stepped cap and flat ledge above a large hooked stem and three broad sweeping strands. Boy connects a loose thread to one of them.

唯.memory: A square mouth sits beside one striped bird.
唯.visual: Left one clean square speaking opening. Right one upright bird with four clear horizontal wing bars and a straight outer stem. Boy points to the single bird.

膨.memory: A ribbed body tile sits beside an expanding drum with three rays.
膨.visual: Left upright rounded body tile and two inside lines. Center a little cross above a square drum box on two braces. At right exactly three detached diagonal sweeps. Boy admires the full drum.

耐.memory: A divided shelf stands beside a small measuring hook.
耐.visual: Left flat top and three descending supports inside an open-bottom frame. Right a vertical hook crossed by a short bar with a detached low dot. Boy puts a tiny weight on the left shelf.

塾.memory: A pair of warm fittings stands over solid ground.
塾.visual: At upper left a dotted cap over a square opening and small hook. At upper right one curled support and an offset round marker. Directly below both an earth cross on wide flat foot. Boy carries a blank notebook.

漏.memory: Three drops lead to rain leaking under a low shelter.
漏.visual: Left exactly three blue droplets. Right a flat roof bending down on the left shields four smaller drops arranged under a centered bar. Boy catches the leak in a tiny bowl.

慶.memory: A broad shelter covers a heart and two festive tails.
慶.visual: Top-and-left roof with centered dot. Inside place a shallow divided frame over a red heart, then one bent crossed ribbon under it. Boy cheers beside the lower end.

猛.memory: A spirited upright dog stands beside a child-shaped tray stand.
猛.visual: Left a narrow, curved upright dog with two short paws. Right a curled cap and upright crossed by a bar over a wide divided dish. Boy observes from below; playful mood.

芳.memory: Grass grows above a little curved flag post.
芳.visual: Two distinct leaf tips across the top. Beneath them one dot and short bar above a long curved flag support that sweeps down-left. Boy smells a tiny blossom at the flag's foot.

懲.memory: Steps, a raised post, and crossed supports sit above a heart.
懲.visual: Top row narrow steps at left, a three-prong peak and horizontal rack in the middle, two crossed braces at right. Center one red heart underneath. Boy considers a gentle game correction.

剣.memory: A roof over a divided box sits beside two upright stage blades.
剣.visual: Left peaked cover over a short bar and square opening on two spread legs. Right two slim stylized wooden stage props on a display stand with one long hooked foot. Boy observes from the side.

彰.memory: A tall stacked sign gives off three slanting marks.
彰.visual: Left a little stand with a dot above a divided square window and a broad lower cross. Right exactly three independent slanted gold marks sweep down-left. Boy points to the sign.

棋.memory: A tree stands beside a wooden game rack on feet.
棋.visual: Left one tall tree with unmistakable 木 silhouette. Right two small pegs cross three stacked rails over a long base and two separate feet. Boy moves one tiny tile at the edge.

恒.memory: A heart sits beside a sun held between two rails.
恒.visual: Left an upright red heart strip with two little accent marks. Right one divided square window sits between two plain horizontal bars, one above and one below. Boy watches its steady light.

揚.memory: A hand lifts a square sun above curled rays.
揚.visual: Left an upright hand. Right a square divided sun tile above a flat rail and three broad curling rays that sweep down-left. Boy lifts one ray from the lower right.

冒.memory: A larger square shelter sits over a tall watchful panel.
冒.visual: Two rectangles stacked: a broad square with two internal lines at top, a slimmer tall eye panel with two inside lines below. Boy peeks from behind them.

倫.memory: A person stands beside a roof over a bound rack.
倫.visual: Boy narrow at far left. Right a pointed roof over one short flat beam and a bold square frame open at the foot, with three straight inner uprights. Boy aligns one shelf marker.

陳.memory: A hill stands beside a divided tree display.
陳.visual: Left a narrow hill with two short steps. Right a tall stem extends through a broad rail and a four-pane square and splays into two roots. Boy displays a tiny token in a lower pane.

憶.memory: A little heart looks at a lamp and larger heart under a stand.
憶.visual: Left narrow red heart stem and two detached marks. Right a capped stand above a divided square lantern and a larger red heart with side dots below. Boy remembers a tiny gift.

潜.memory: Water drops meet two bar frames stacked over a sun tile.
潜.visual: Left three drops. Right two side-by-side upright stands with splayed feet and crossed rails. Directly below both one square sun with a center stripe. Boy watches it sink into a narrow water line.

梨.memory: A stem and two slim bars sit above a pear tree.
梨.visual: Upper left a golden grain stalk, upper right two tall straight divider strips. Center a large 木-shaped pear tree beneath them with cross branches, splayed roots, and two tiny pears. Boy picks one pear.

克.memory: An old sign stands on two outward curved feet.
克.visual: A small cross directly above a wide square opening. Under it exactly two large feet splay toward the sides, right one curled inward at its tip. Boy steps out of the doorway.

岳.memory: A stacked terrace rests over a three-peaked mountain.
岳.visual: Top a long slanted ledge and two narrow level steps on one stem. Underneath put three visible peaks standing on one common base, middle highest. Boy reaches the middle peak.

概.memory: A tree sits by a paneled shape and a wide curled foot.
概.visual: Left bold tree shape. Middle rectangular two-bar panel with a short splayed foot. Right two short rails over two curling legs, right one curving up. Boy traces the three shapes from below.

拘.memory: A hand holds a hooked roof around a small square.
拘.visual: Left tall wrist and two fingers. Right a curved upper beam turns down on the far right and wraps one square opening at lower left. Boy holds a tiny peg near the edge.

黙.memory: A dark marked stack and a small figure rest above four embers.
黙.visual: Top left four-pane panel above two short rails, right a little friendly dog with slanting legs and a small dot. Exactly four separate embers below both. Boy keeps one finger gently near his lips.

須.memory: Three slanted marks line up beside a head-shaped tile.
須.visual: Left exactly three parallel narrow sweeps diagonally down-left. Right one tall rectangular head panel with a top tab, two bars and two little splayed feet. Boy points from the lower gap.

偏.memory: A person stands off to the side of a roofed divided rack.
偏.visual: Boy narrow and upright on left. Right overhang with separate top lintel and descending left wall shelters a tall divided frame with three visible upright compartments. Boy points to the side of the frame.

雰.memory: Rain covers two slope marks and a curved band.
雰.visual: Top wide canopy with central stem and four detached rain drops. Beneath center two short outward diagonals above one bent strip with a curved foot. Boy notices a little breeze near it.

遇.memory: A road curls around a divided mask with a tucked tail.
遇.visual: At upper right one four-pane square mask on a tall open-bottom companion frame with a curled tail. Start with one little isolated path dot at upper left. Road bends under the mask. Boy meets a tiny friend on it.

諮.memory: Speech joins a square mouth beneath a bending figure.
諮.visual: Left dot, speech bars and square mouth. Right two blue dashes and a short bent cap over two slanted legs, then a square mouth on the bottom. Boy consults with a friend.

狭.memory: An upright dog meets a narrow crossing frame.
狭.visual: Left narrow curved dog silhouette and two paws. Right two strong rails and two tiny braces flank one upright stem that opens into a wide pair of legs. Leave a narrow gap between sides.

卓.memory: A tall mark rises above a square sun and cross.
卓.visual: One tall vertical tab with a small right projection. Directly beneath it one square divided sun tile, then a small cross-shaped foot. Boy admires the tall marker.

亀.memory: A turtle shell sits above a long curled foot.
亀.visual: A short crooked cap above a tall boxy shell divided by an upright and two short bars. The central upright emerges below and curves up to the right. Boy watches the friendly turtle.

糧.memory: A grain star sits beside stacked divided food shelves.
糧.visual: Left prominent rice-grain star crossing a single vertical stem. Right a square window with a stripe immediately above a longer rail, then a four-pane box on two stacked rails. Boy gathers a small portion.

簿.memory: Bamboo covers water drops and a measured tile.
簿.visual: Two bamboo clusters overhead. Lower left three blue drops, lower right one divided square with projecting peg and dot above a hooked measuring post. Boy carries blank slips alongside it.

炉.memory: A flame sits beside a long lintel and sloping hearth door.
炉.visual: Left one friendly flame with two detached sparks and splayed lower tips. Right a separate top lintel above a small upper rectangular panel and sloping left leg. Boy warms his hands outside the fireplace.

殊.memory: A slanting folded marker stands beside a red tree.
殊.visual: Left two short roofs over an angular folded ribbon and a little offset dot. Right short slanted accent over red stem crossed by two boughs, with broad splayed roots. Boy admires its unusual color.

殖.memory: A folded marker sits beside a growing tall divided frame.
殖.visual: Left short angled cap over tucked ribbon and small dot. Right narrow upright frame with three interior bars, top cross and broad flat low base. Boy adds one small growing bead at the base.

艦.memory: A narrow boat stands beside a watchful tray assembly.
艦.visual: Left tall wooden boat seen from overhead with two short deck markings. Right a square eye panel and slanted cap over a broad shallow divided tray. Boy observes the display at the side.

輩.memory: Two outward-barred posts sit over a square cart.
輩.visual: Top two parallel uprights with three short outward bars each. Below center one square wagon body crossed by a middle stem and two strong horizontal rails. Boy meets a friend beside the wagon.

奇.memory: A wide figure perches above a doorway inside a hooked beam.
奇.visual: Top one broad spread shape with two slanting feet. Below a long horizontal beam turns down at far right. Tuck one clearly square doorway beneath the beam to the left of its right hook. Boy peeks around the opening.

慢.memory: A little heart sits next to a stack of sun, net and crossed ribbons.
慢.visual: Left a vertical red heart mark with two side dots. Right a divided square sun over one shallow four-pane window, above two wide crossing bands. Boy takes a moment to rest.

鶴.memory: A capped small bird stands beside a large crane.
鶴.visual: Left a broad low cap over a slim upright bird with four side stripes. Right a larger toy crane with tall neck and four short detached marks at its feet. Boy looks up beside both birds.

謀.memory: Speech meets a little drawer over a wooden stand.
謀.visual: Left speech bars and a square speaking opening. Right a shallow tray with pegs above its top and one short inner line, directly above a large 木 stand. Boy shares a tiny blank plan.

拍.memory: A raised hand sits beside a little white tile.
拍.visual: Left a tall open hand, its upright wrist visible. Right a white square with short angled cap and one horizontal inside bar. Boy claps near the bottom.

寛.memory: A roof shelters two sprouts and a watchful figure.
寛.visual: One roof with top dot at top. Beneath it two small grass tips above one tall rectangular eye with two bars and two softly splayed feet. Boy gives the figure room.

覆.memory: A window sits above steps and a returning sun panel.
覆.visual: Top a long flat canopy divided into panes. Beneath left short slanted steps above a post. Beneath right a tilted cap, divided sun tile and crossed return paths. Boy turns a tiny shallow bowl at its base.

胞.memory: A ribbed body tile stands next to a rounded wrapper.
胞.visual: Left tall rounded tile and two little horizontal bars. Right broad upper cap curves down on right around a squared curled strip. Boy examines the little wrapper from the outside.

隔.memory: A tall cliff stands beside a divided chamber above upright legs.
隔.visual: Left narrow ridge with two ledges. Right short rail above one square opening and a wide framed base with two inner vertical dividers. Boy stands in the gap.

浄.memory: Three water drops rinse a set of crooked horizontal rails.
浄.visual: Left three blue drops. Right a short bent cap above several short horizontal shelves crossed by a long upright with a hooked foot. Boy wipes a small corner.

没.memory: Three drops pass a hooked support above crossed strips.
没.visual: Left three big drops. Right two little curled stands over two broad crossing strips. Boy watches one tiny toy float dip down beside the strips.

暇.memory: A divided sun rests beside small racks and a low curl.
暇.visual: Left a square gold sun with one dividing line. Right an upright at left, small square shoulder at right and a pair of sweeping folded arms below. Boy relaxes at the lower edge.

貞.memory: A little tall marker stands above a shell on two feet.
貞.visual: At top one tall peg with one short right-facing branch. Under it a tall upright shell with two horizontal inside bands and two little outward feet. Boy checks that the peg stands straight.

鑑.memory: Metal stands by a watchful panel over a little tray.
鑑.visual: Left triangular gold cap over rails and tiny ingots. Right a small eye window and slanted cap side by side over a wide shallow divided tray. Boy inspects one corner.

陰.memory: A narrow hill shadows a roof and two curled layers.
陰.visual: Left high narrow cliff with two ledges. Right peaked cover over a small angled fold and dot, then two straight bars over a curled cloud. Boy rests beside the shade.

銘.memory: Metal stands beside a crescent resting on a square opening.
銘.visual: Left a peaked gold cap over stacked rails and two ingots. Right a bent crescent with a short inner dash over a square opening. Boy points at the blank opening.

随.memory: A cliff and a ribbed marker flank a slow path.
随.visual: Left narrow cliff with two protruding steps. Right crossed cap over a tall two-strip panel. A road begins from a detached dot near the middle left and swings underneath. Boy follows the curve.

烈.memory: Two upright dividers stand over four bright embers.
烈.visual: Upper left a short cap over tucked ribbon with one small offset dot, upper right two straight shiny posts with one hook. Below both exactly four glowing embers in a row. Boy watches from afar.

尋.memory: Two horizontal fittings meet over a measuring hook.
尋.visual: Top a short folded boxlike cap. Middle left two rails joined by short stem and middle right a single square opening. Under both one long hook crosses a measure rail and detached dot. Boy searches nearby.

稿.memory: A grain stalk stands beside a tall two-room tower.
稿.visual: Left tall grain sprig with crossing boughs and splayed roots. Right dot and cap over one square opening, then a wider open-bottom frame with a smaller square inside. Boy shows a tiny blank draft.

丹.memory: A red open-bottom frame holds one small dot and one strong rail.
丹.visual: One tall open-bottom vermilion frame with top, left and right edges, and a tiny inward bend at right foot. Put one little diagonal mark inside in the upper half and one long rail extending across the middle. Boy carries a tiny red chip.
